name: cosmemilton/acbr-php
description: Framework-independent PHP client for the pinned ACBr NF-e/NFC-e Linux worker

suggest.ext-zlib: Required only to install the pinned native .tgz archive
suggest.ext-pcntl: Required for optional Linux asynchronous queue
suggest.ext-posix: Required for optional Linux asynchronous queue
suggest.ext-openssl: Required only for synthetic signing test certificate generation
suggest.ext-dom: Required only for independent XMLDSig verification in tests
